summary: Coya Therapeutics filed an 8-K on May 12, 2026, disclosing entry into a Sales Agreement with Leerink Partners LLC as sales agent. The agreement allows Coya to sell up to $30 million of its common stock in at-the-market offerings under an existing shelf registration statement. Leerink receives a 3% commission. There are no fixed prices, deadlines, or change-of-control provisions. This is a routine equity distribution facility, not a special situation.
